metadata.description: ogxo plugins for Claude Code, Grok Build, and Codex: Thryx project management, multi-agent code review, git/GitHub workflow skills, live browser debugging, and war-room decision support.

plugins.name: ogxo
plugins.description: The ogxo plugin set in one install: code review, git and GitHub workflows, browser debugging, decision and planning skills, color-system design, safety hooks, specialist subagents, and the status line. Installing it installs each of those plugins; thryx (needs a Thryx account) and ogxo-format (rewrites every file Claude edits) are left out and install on their own.

plugins.name: thryx
plugins.description: Thryx project management over MCP: issues, projects, cycles, milestones, and documents in your Thryx workspace.

plugins.name: ogxo-review
plugins.description: Multi-agent code review: full-review cross-correlates several reviewers and filters false positives; code-review-git posts line-level findings as a GitHub PR review. Bundles the code-review-agent, security-auditor, and code-metrics-analyst agents. Also security-check, a focused security review of a branch, and the dependency-auditor agent.

plugins.name: ogxo-git
plugins.description: Git and GitHub workflow skills: Conventional Commit messages, PR titles and descriptions with template detection, resolving PR review threads (its workflow instructs it to present its analysis and wait for approval before replying or resolving), and a catchup command to restore branch context. Also release, quick-fix, and ship-feature workflows, and changelog-generator and release-notes skills.

plugins.name: ogxo-debug
plugins.description: Debug a running web app by driving the browser: reproduce the symptom, read console and network errors, fix, and verify in the page. Also css-alignment-debug, which injects temporary outline overlays and reads a screenshot of the rendered page for layout bugs that won't resolve from reading source. Also browser-testing: Playwright test scripts with dev-server detection; Playwright installs into the plugin's data directory during a one-time setup.

plugins.name: ogxo-decide
plugins.description: War room: multi-persona deliberation for hard-to-reverse decisions, with game-theory lenses, a red-team pass, and a portfolio of options instead of a single winner. Also prd-create (section-by-section PRDs with pressure-testing, optionally saved to Thryx as a document plus epic and stories), task-architect (turns an idea into an agent-ready prompt), and the architecture-advisor agent. Also diagram-generator: Mermaid diagrams from a description or from the codebase.

plugins.name: ogxo-design
plugins.description: Recolor: audit an app's color usage, then implement a cohesive, accessible, token-based color system grounded in color theory, with contrast ratios computed by a bundled script.

plugins.name: ogxo-guards
plugins.description: Safety hooks: reject a `git add` whose command text names a .env/credentials/.secret/.pem file, reject Edit/Write calls on lock files and on node_modules/, vendor/, and .git/ paths, and reject single file writes over 1,048,576 characters. Pattern-based, so it does not catch everything; see the README. Requires jq.

plugins.name: ogxo-format
plugins.description: Formatting hooks after every Edit/Write: format the changed file with prettier, gofmt, rustfmt, or black when found, whether or not the project uses that formatter; report trailing whitespace back to Claude; and check YAML syntax. Requires jq.

plugins.name: ogxo-specialists
plugins.description: Specialist subagents that take a noisy job and return one structured report: log-analyst (correlate logs to a root cause), codebase-archaeologist (map an unfamiliar or legacy system), performance-optimizer (measure, fix by impact, re-measure), and migration-specialist (breaking-change catalog and a phased plan with rollback points).

plugins.name: ogxo-statusline
plugins.description: Status line for Claude Code and Grok Build: model, context use, git branch and changes, session time, effort, output tokens, and session cost. Claude Code also shows thinking, prompt-cache state, and 5-hour, 7-day, and spend-limit bars. Grok Build uses the live context window, session output and cache-read share, and the active turn. /ogxo-statusline:setup writes Claude settings; /ogxo-statusline:setup-grok writes [ui.status_line] in the Grok user config. Requires jq.
